column1: # agl NDSR: 24 spatial neural upscaler alternatives. Native compute is corrected but remains much slower on Adreno.
# Compatible dispatches use a spatial blit; DM_VK_UPSCALER_CUBIC=1 selects hardware Catmull-Rom only for audited linear-output keys.
# Original SASS and translated SPIR-V classify 16 linear-output variants and 8 encoded-output variants (README.md).
# First-launch setting only: use handheld mode on the physical 1080p display. Existing device/user settings are preserved on install.

# The Adreno governor parks at 660 MHz under a steady load; the 967 MHz floor (through su, Magisk) cut p95 frame time 47 → 36 ms in the docked tunnel. Without su it is refused and logged, nothing else
# Cave tuning (2026-11-07, handheld). ADPF 90 is an 11.11 ms CPU work hint, independent of game pacing/display rate. Completed-frame accounting remains off after its latency/throughput A/B.
# DM_VK_PASS_SPLIT=128 measured best in handheld (frame work p50 16.66 ms against 17.4 ms unsplit; 256 was between)
# Outdoors (2026-11-08, handheld, Ingotis gate, 12,200 draws a frame): the backend now paces its 32 command-buffer parts over the frame (DM_VK_PART_PACE, on by default),
# 46.2 -> 34.2 ms frames standing still and 30 -> ~56 fps on the smash route. With it PASS_SPLIT 128 and 512 measure the same, PASS_SPLIT_DEPTH=0 is worse (40.3 ms), CB_DRAWS 2048 no better
# The host's adaptive frame rate (60 → 40 → 30 fps steps, perf_android.c) is off: the game paces itself by whole 60 Hz vsyncs (present interval 1, 2, 3) and steps its clock by them, so a
# 40 fps presentation it cannot name ran it in slow motion. With it off the frames stay on screen exactly the interval the game set
